title: Brick and Marble in the Middle Ages: Notes of Tours in the North of Italy
sourceTitle: Brick and Marble in the Middle Ages: Notes of Tours in the North of Italy
author: George Edmund Street
description: "Brick and Marble in the Middle Ages: Notes of Tours in the North of Italy" by George Edmund Street is a travelogue featuring architectural observations written in the mid-19th century.
longDescription: This work details Street's journeys through northern Italy as he explores and describes various Gothic architectural styles and historical sites.

authorInfo.bio: George Edmund Street (1824–1881) wrote Brick and Marble in the Middle Ages: Notes of Tours in the North of Italy. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
